outcome: obstetrical outcomes (preterm birth, small for gestational age, birthweight)
cardiac outcomes (cardiac events, arrhythmias, heart failure)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 18 pregnant women with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, experiencing a total of 27 pregnancies that reached at least 20 weeks of gestation.
finding: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy is associated with prematurity and small for gestational age, and left ventricular outflow tract obstruction is linked to adverse cardiac events.
birth_weight: Mainly distributed below the 50th percentile (89%), with 35% of neonates born small for gestational age (below 10th percentile) and severe cases (below 5th percentile) observed.
gest_age: More than 50% preterm birth, with most deliveries being late preterm (34-36 6/7 weeks), and small for gestational age defined as birthweight below the 10th percentile.
